stories.title: Pope Leo warns that AI is becoming a new test of human dignity, work and power
stories.summary: In an encyclical, Pope Leo says AI poses a threat to human dignity.

stories.title: How Uyghurs from China helped Syrian rebels overthrow Bashar al-Assad
stories.summary: Motivated to avenge their families in China, Uyghur mercenaries became valued fighting partners for Syria's rebels. Their participation helped Syria's new president ultimately win Syria's civil war.

stories.title: The Space Nerd Club discusses new findings from the James Webb telescope
stories.summary: New findings from the James Webb Space Telescope include cloudy weather on an exoplanet, and clues to the origins of one of Neptune's moons.

stories.title: In West Texas, an unlikely alliance stands against extending the border wall
stories.summary: An unusual coalition of people across the political spectrum have banded together to rally against a border wall in the Big Bend.

stories.title: The removal of a whale mural in Dallas ahead of World Cup has caused a stir
stories.summary: A mural of whales promoting conservation was covered up in Dallas to make way for a new mural promoting the FIFA World Cup, which kicks off next month. But the project has stirred up controversy.

stories.title: An older kid stepped up to save him from bullies — and changed his life
stories.summary: As a sixth-grader, Darrell Barber was the new kid at school and a target for bullies. An eighth-grader named Marcus became his protector.
